edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, tying contract ownership to the caller.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before the new owner can be proposed.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before ownership is swapped.
onlyOwner modifier gates the arbitrary external token call on msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is the account debited by transfer, so caller identity controls the funds moved.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written in allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender is used as the spender key when decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender].
msg.sender receives the allowance and is forwarded as the from argument to the external callback.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner and resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes the initial total supply.
Constructor mints the whole supply into the deployer balance mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] before subtracting it.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
transfer writes both the sender and recipient entries of the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
transferFrom writes the from and to entries of the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external callback.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the caller-supplied spender contract after updating the allowance, allowing reentrant execution.
transferAnyERC20Token executes untrusted external code at an owner-supplied token address, enabling reentrancy during the call.
totalSupply performs _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without SafeMath, so an underflow is not guarded.
Parameter to is the recipient used by transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved by transfer.
Parameter spender is the allowance key used by approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value stored by approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount debited from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
Parameter spender is approved and then called back by approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is the allowance amount set by approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
Parameter _newOwner is stored as the pending owner by transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the external contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is forwarded to the external token transfer.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Local named return variable balance carries the value returned by balanceOf.
Local named return variable remaining carries the value returned by allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: Transfer recipient parameter is only meaningful inside the transfer function and should be folded into it.
Transfer amount parameter should be normalized into the transfer function.
Approve spender parameter should be normalized into the approve function.
Approve amount parameter should be normalized into the approve function.
TransferFrom source parameter should be normalized into the transferFrom function.
TransferFrom destination parameter should be normalized into the transferFrom function.
TransferFrom amount parameter should be normalized into the transferFrom function.
ApproveAndCall spender parameter should be normalized into the approveAndCall function that also drives the external callback.
ApproveAndCall amount parameter should be normalized into the approveAndCall function.
ApproveAndCall data parameter is forwarded to the external callback and belongs to the approveAndCall function.
New owner parameter should be normalized into the transferOwnership function.
Token address parameter feeds the external call and should be normalized into transferAnyERC20Token.
Token amount parameter should be normalized into transferAnyERC20Token.
Token owner parameter should be normalized into the balanceOf function.
Allowance owner parameter should be normalized into the allowance function.
Allowance spender parameter should be normalized into the allowance function.
Named return local balance should be folded into the balanceOf function.
Named return local remaining should be folded into the allowance function.
